rows: Insert Test plug type RTXH into Test socket type RTXP 18 on relay 27G.
Short-circuit points (9, 11) on the Test Plug.
Short-circuit points (1, 3) on the Test Plug.
Inject 100 V at points (9, 10) on the Test Plug.
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears.
Record the voltage reading for element RXEG 21 D29,107 and also element RXEG21 D29,307.
Connect the Stop leads of the time measuring instrument to points (15, 16) on element RXEG21 D29,119.
Connect the Start leads of the time measuring instrument to points T1, T2 on the PHU-100 injection test set.
Inject voltage of 100 V at points (9, 10) on the Test Plug.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Record the time counter reading t1 for element RXEG 21 D29,119.
Connect the Stop leads of the time measuring instrument to points (15, 16) on element RXEG 21 D29,319.
Inject voltage of 100 V at points (9, 10) on the Test Plug.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Record the time counter reading t2 for element RXEG21 D29,319.
Remove Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type PTXP 18 on relay x27G.

Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the earth protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at Assiut New Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company. The field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 18 October 2002.
Safety Precautions
The unit is out of service.
Open the work order and ensure the availability of an occupational safety and health card.
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.

Procedures to be Carried Out
Insert Test plug type RTXH into Test socket type RTXP 18 on relay 27G. | 1
Short-circuit points (9, 11) on the Test Plug. | 2
Short-circuit points (1, 3) on the Test Plug. | 3
Inject 100 V at points (9, 10) on the Test Plug. | 4
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears. | 5
Record the voltage reading for element RXEG 21 D29,107 and also element RXEG21 D29,307. | 6
Connect the Stop leads of the time measuring instrument to points (15, 16) on element RXEG21 D29,119. | 7
Connect the Start leads of the time measuring instrument to points T1, T2 on the PHU-100 injection test set. | 8
Inject voltage of 100 V at points (9, 10) on the Test Plug. | 9
Switch off the voltage injection test set. | 10
Record the time counter reading t1 for element RXEG 21 D29,119. | 11
Connect the Stop leads of the time measuring instrument to points (15, 16) on element RXEG 21 D29,319. | 12
Inject voltage of 100 V at points (9, 10) on the Test Plug. | 13
Switch off the voltage injection test set. | 14
Record the time counter reading t2 for element RXEG21 D29,319. | 15
Remove Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type PTXP 18 on relay x27G. | 16
